title: Creative Staged Update
description: A change to a live creative that the seller accepted in staged mode and has not yet promoted. The creative's approved prior version keeps serving under the same creative_id until the seller promotes this update. A creative has at most one staged update; a later staged sync with different content supersedes it, a sync of the same staged content leaves it and its review unchanged, and a sync whose content equals the serving version withdraws it. Once promoted, the staged content and revision_id become the creative's current state and this object is removed.

status.description: Review state of the staged update. rejected appears only when the seller's on_rejection is keeps_prior; the prior version keeps serving until the buyer supersedes or withdraws the update.

revision_id.description: Buyer-authored revision of the staged content, when the sync supplied one. The creative's top-level revision_id stays the serving revision until promotion.

change_kinds.description: Kinds of change the staged update makes relative to the serving version.

staged_at.description: When the seller accepted the staged update.

rejection_reason.description: Human-readable reason. Present only when status is rejected.
